lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 10-12 vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in an irregular grid starting posterior to the gill region and extending along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs to form primary grid-like anchor nodes visible along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique curvilinear 'hook' or 'swirl' arrangement of spots is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, distinct from the surrounding grid pattern.
